name: Office Hours Cancellation (Instructor Notice)
description: Sent to the instructor when a student cancels an office-hours booking, so the slot is known to be free
subject: Office Hours Cancelled — $student_name on $booking_date
body_text:
Dear $instructor_name,

$student_name has cancelled their office hours booking with you. The slot is free again.

--------------------------------------------------
CANCELLED BOOKING
--------------------------------------------------

Booking ID:    $booking_id
Student:       $student_name ($student_id)
Date:          $booking_date  ($day_of_week)
Time:          $start_time - $end_time
Location:      $location

Cancelled by:  $cancelled_by
Cancelled on:  $cancelled_on
Reason:        $cancellation_reason

--------------------------------------------------

No action is needed. The slot has been returned to your available capacity and can be booked by another student.

$signature

instructor_name.description: Name of the instructor whose slot was cancelled

student_name.description: Name of the student who cancelled

booking_date.description: Date the appointment was booked for (YYYY-MM-DD)

day_of_week.description: Day of the week for the slot

location.description: Where the office hours were to be held

signature.description: Email signature; supplied by the renderer when omitted
